rules.full: gradual holiday adaptation, no fixed ranges
rules.fast: gradual holiday adaptation, no fixed ranges
rules.easy: no social adaptation; positive gains x1.5; negative effects zero
rules.goalkeeper: ability above 70 gradually reduces concede lambda and event goal probability up to 50%; substitutes scale 65%; absence and coach excluded
rules.goldenGlove: goalkeeper appearance; completed final; total regular-time cup goals conceded <=2 including absences; shootout excluded
rules.academicFailure: mandatory after annual growth if academy <60; once per calendar year; manual in all modes; excludes service and interrupted years; easy penalties zero
